name: Gyönk (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Gyönk (a yellow and green shield with a bunch of grapes, an oak bough and a white ploughshare, with a helm and mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed GYÖNK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Gyönk arms with helm, mantling and scroll
